_comment: Sweep-2 — focused on sweep-1 findings. ksize=7 dominates; min_area is the key trade-off axis. Generation params kept for diversity across records but not swept in C2.

_sweep1_findings.ksize_7_dominates: Every top-10 pipeline uses ksize=7. ksize>=11 degrades quality in every comparison.
_sweep1_findings.threshold_irrelevant_at_ksize7: Pipes 0002 (thresh=50) and 0004 (thresh=110) produced identical results — morphological close repairs the threshold mask regardless.
_sweep1_findings.min_area_is_key: min_area=7 → gamma=1.0 but alpha=3.3 px; min_area>=50 → gamma=0.93 but alpha=0.52 px. Cross-over elbow is somewhere between 7 and 50.
_sweep1_findings.max_contours_0_is_fatal: pipe-0006 (max_c=0, ksize=7, min_area=7) → alpha=51 px from centroid smear.
_sweep1_findings.bg_history_varThreshold_untested: Both fixed at 500 / 16 in sweep-1. Need separate sweep.

pipeline.morph_ksize.rationale: Finer grid around the sweep-1 optimum (ksize=7). ksize=5 is the untested smaller end; ksize=11 is where quality begins to degrade. Drop 15 and 21 — confirmed uncompetitive in sweep-1.

pipeline.contour_min_area.rationale: Key trade-off axis found in sweep-1. 7 levels give resolution to find the sensitivity/accuracy elbow between 7 and 60 px². Keeping 500 as upper bound for stress-testing.

pipeline.binary_threshold.rationale: Kept for robustness, but expected low impact within ksize=7 (sweep-1 confirmation). Removed 140 — consistently hurt every cluster.

pipeline.contour_max_contours.rationale: max_contours=0 is proven fatal (alpha=51 px from smear). max_contours=1 is best observed so far. max_contours=2 may help recover fragmented animal blobs at moderate min_area — untested.

pipeline.bg_history.rationale: NEW in sweep-2. Controls how quickly MOG2 adapts the background. Shorter history → faster response to slow-moving or returning animals; critical for static (dead animal) records. sweep-1 fixed at 500.

pipeline.bg_var_threshold.rationale: NEW in sweep-2. MOG2 per-pixel movement sensitivity. Lower → more foreground pixels for low-contrast / slow animals; higher → cleaner mask with fewer false blobs. sweep-1 fixed at 16.

_generation_params_reference.note: These control the synthetic record content (diversity across gen set), not the pipeline. Not swept in C2.
